title: Projected Normal Models on Recursively Curved Tori
summary: We develop a computationally tractable statistical framework for angular data supported on a recursively embedded curved torus $\mathbb{T}^n\hookrightarrow\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$. Due to the recursive structure we build an exact uniform sampler by generalizing the process from the curved 2-torus. We generalize projected normal distributions to the curved $n$-torus and we develop inference theory for these distributions.
